string.name: desktop_schedule_creation_create_prompt
string.value: Please create an automation task based on the requirements.

string.name: desktop_schedule_creation_empty_all
string.value: No tasks yet. Tasks created in your sessions appear here.

string.name: desktop_schedule_daily_brief_description
string.value: Recent changes in the workspace and what needs follow-up, with what to do first today.

string.name: desktop_schedule_daily_brief_prompt
string.value: Create an automation task named "Daily brief": every weekday at 9:00, review the last 24 hours of changes in the current workspace and list what needs my follow-up and what to do first today; when the workspace is a code repository, also cover new commits, pull requests awaiting my review, and failing CI.

string.name: desktop_schedule_weekly_review_description
string.value: Your work in the workspace this week, with loose ends and what to do first next week.

string.name: desktop_schedule_weekly_review_prompt
string.value: Create an automation task named "Weekly review": every Friday at 16:00, review what I did in the current workspace this week and list what is still unfinished and what to do first next week; when the workspace is a code repository, look only at my commits this week and the pull requests I opened that were merged this week or are still open. Summarize here only; do not change files in the workspace.

string.name: desktop_schedule_issue_scan_description
string.value: Sort new issues into bugs, requests, and questions, and flag duplicates and ones that need a reply.

string.name: desktop_schedule_issue_scan_prompt
string.value: Create an automation task named "Issue scan": every weekday at 10:00, scan new issues in the current workspace repository, sort them into bugs, requests, and questions, and flag duplicates and ones that need my reply. Summarize here only; do not reply on GitHub.

string.name: desktop_schedule_plugin_compat_description
string.value: When a new DSH version ships, check whether installed and self-made plugins need changes.

string.name: desktop_schedule_plugin_compat_prompt
string.value: Create an automation task named "Plugin compatibility check": every day at 10:00, check whether a new DSH version is available; if so, read its upgrade guide, check whether each non-official or self-made plugin I have installed is affected, and list what to change and how.

string.name: desktop_schedule_topic_tracking_description
string.value: Search for news and new arXiv papers on chosen topics and list the key points.

string.name: desktop_schedule_topic_tracking_prompt
string.value: Create an automation task named "Topic and paper tracking": every day at 9:00, search for new articles and arXiv papers on the topics I follow and list a few key points for each. Before creating it, ask me for the topics, keywords, and sources.

string.name: desktop_schedule_branch_cleanup_description
string.value: List local branches and worktrees whose pull requests merged or closed, and delete them after confirmation.

string.name: desktop_schedule_branch_cleanup_prompt
string.value: Create an automation task named "Branch and worktree cleanup": every Friday at 17:00, list local branches and worktrees in the current workspace whose pull requests are merged or closed, and delete them only after I confirm.

string.name: desktop_schedule_weather_description
string.value: Weather for today and the next three days, with a note when an umbrella or warmer clothes are needed.

string.name: desktop_schedule_weather_prompt
string.value: Create an automation task named "Weather and travel": every day at 7:30, tell me the weather in my city for today and the next three days, and call out when I should bring an umbrella, dress warmer, or expect travel disruption. Before creating it, ask me for my city.

string.name: desktop_schedule_workout_description
string.value: Plan next week's workouts around your goals and training days.

string.name: desktop_schedule_workout_prompt
string.value: Create an automation task named "Weekly workout plan": every Sunday at 20:00, plan my workouts for next week around my goals and the days I can train, without asking me anything when it runs. Before creating it, ask me about my goals, how many days a week I can train, which days I am free, and where I train.
